_comment: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B image-to-video: a still this project already generated, given motion. UNVERIFIED against a live server — unlike the two t2v graphs, this one is not transcribed from an official ComfyUI example, because Wan 2.2's 5B is a unified T2V/I2V model with its own latent node (Wan22ImageToVideoLatent) rather than the 2.1 image path. Wan 2.1 I2V additionally needs CLIPVisionLoader + CLIPVisionEncode with clip_vision_h; 2.2's 5B does not, which is most of why it is the free-tier pick. If a run fails at graph-submit with an unknown node, that is this comment being right and the graph needing a look at the server's /object_info.
